items.title: Why Is Thermo Fisher Scientific (TMO) Building A Massive Early Disease Data Platform?
items.summary: Thermo Fisher Scientific (NYSE:TMO) and Mayo Clinic announced the formation of Precure, LLC for early disease detection using multi omic data. Precure plans to integrate proteomic, genomic, and longitudinal clinical records into a single biomedical dataset to identify early disease signals. The collaboration positions Thermo Fisher Scientific’s technology at the center of large scale healthcare data generation for research and clinical decision support.
